# POINT-FORMAL-ERROR-METHOD v0.1 Recovery Brief

Status: `unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval`; separate quarantined
recovery not launched

## Objective

Recover an implementation-independent authority for marginal formal parameter
errors and, only where explicitly included, joint parameter covariance. This
record is scientifically and lifecycle-distinct from the numerical point
estimator.

## Required Record

The returned record shall bind:

- fitted parameterization and every parameter transformation;
- stochastic covariance or residual model and its relationship to fit weights;
- exact Jacobian, Hessian, Fisher, profile, sandwich, or other construction,
  including observed/expected curvature;
- residual scaling, degrees of freedom, rank and positive-definiteness gates;
- marginal extraction and covariance/error units;
- active-bound, circular-angle, major/minor-axis, weak-identification, and
  rank-deficiency behavior;
- finite, positive, and consistency checks;
- conditional scope and omitted uncertainty terms; and
- unavailable and failed states.

An optimizer-reported covariance is not authority merely because it is finite.
A fitted value may coexist with unavailable formal uncertainty. Missing formal
uncertainty never means zero uncertainty, diagonal covariance, or
independence.

## Release Gate

The method remains unavailable until its exact sanitized bytes, identity,
scope, and digest receive explicit scientific-owner approval. Until then all
marginal formal errors, joint covariance unless separately authorized,
`fitted_amplitude_over_formal_amplitude_error`, legacy `fit_sig2noise`, and
named uses requiring formal uncertainty fail closed without erasing otherwise
valid fit products.
